summary: Finished the Protocol v26 project-service migration: created a new project-service-routing.test.ts in apps/agent-server (after splitting it out of websocket-server.lifecycle.test.ts), updated docs/extensions.md and WORKLOG.md with the v26 entry, and fixed a stale type import in the registry's unity-view.test.ts. Fixed a test typo (fakeService(() => {}) → fakeService()) that broke tsc. All gizmo packages typecheck and test green (123 agent-server + 174 app + extensions/protocol tests), svelte-check clean, prettier clean, and vite production build succeeds; registry tsc and 144 tests pass; web bundles rebuilt.
decisions: Use a project-local temp path (.new-tests.txt under tests/transport) instead of /tmp when feeding bash-produced content to Windows Python, because /tmp is not visible to Windows python in this environment.
Drop the dummy `() => {}` argument from fakeService() calls in project-service-routing.test.ts since the factory takes no arguments (TS2554 at three call sites).
Date the new WORKLOG.md entry 2026-09-01 (queried via `date +%F`) rather than inventing or reusing the prior 2026-08-29 entry.

Fix unity-view.test.ts to import UnityStatus from `../types` instead of `@gizmo/protocol`, since UnityStatus is no longer exported from the protocol package after the v26 cleanup and the registry root tsconfig wouldn't catch it via tsc anyway.
Leave unrelated uncommitted changes in the registry repo and uncommitted gizmo state intact; the check:loc failures observed are pre-existing at HEAD.
errors: Python FileNotFoundError on /tmp/new-tests.txt — fixed by copying to tests/transport/.new-tests.txt so Windows Python could read the bash-produced file.
TS2554 'Expected 0 arguments, but got 1' at three fakeService(() => {}) call sites in project-service-routing.test.ts — fixed by removing the empty arrow argument.
